messages:
sam: planning a quick flip for llm-route v3 tonight. Proposal: stepped FF enable with session-guard pin for existing sessions + quiet-window so we don't hit spikes. Draft runbook below.

deploybot: window scheduled 2026-04-01 01:00 UTC. ramp steps: 1%,5%,25%,100% with 8m soak. session-guard: pin existing sessions to v2 for 45m. quiet-window: reduce ramp aggressiveness for first 20m. Command: `/deploybot ff ramp --name=llm-route-v3 --steps=1,5,25,100 --soak=8m --session-guard=45m --quiet-window=20m`

lia: prefer first step 0.5% if possible. Also add verbosity: deploybot should post cohort counts and error deltas after each step.

sre_oncall: I'll be monitoring. Alert triggers: error rate +2% absolute for 5m OR p99 > 600ms -> auto-stepdown one level and notify #eng-oncall. If REQ_ERRORS > 4x baseline for 2m -> emergency disable to v2.

ops: We'll pin v2 for cohorts C,D for 1h to keep rollback simple. Pin command in runbook. Unpin only after 30m stability at 100% or manual approval.

sam: release notes line: "llm-route v3 gradual enable with session-guard and quiet-window to limit early surge. Canary & rollback thresholds in runbook." Adding commands to release doc.

lia: adding a post-deploy smoke: hit /health and /llmroute/ready endpoints for 15m after 100% and share histograms.

sre_oncall: I'll open a short dashboard and enable request tracing for first 30m. Ready to cut if alarms fire.

sam: rollback procedure: `/deploybot ff set llm-route-v3 0` then unpin cohorts and validate v2 for 15m. Keep this thread pinned during the window. :white_check_mark:
